text:
claire-cs: heads-up — KiteHealth reported that their latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after last night's canary cutover. They say lines are just not rendering in the console, graphs only show median.
claire-cs: they attached a screenshot and said metrics are present in org view but panels blank for project view :thinking:
deploy-bot: Deployment v1.23.4 -> prod complete at 2023-09-10T02:05:00Z (canary cutover)
oliver-support: cc @maria-platform @raj-sre — can you triage? customer is in paid dedicated plan, high priority.
maria-platform: taking a look. which dashboard url?
claire-cs: https://console.redwood.com/orgs/kitehealth/projects/prod/dashboards/latency-overview
raj-sre: quick check: are percentiles present in raw TSDB? pinging metrics team.
raj-sre: ran a direct query:
```
curl -s 'https://metrics.api.redwood/v1/query?expr=redwood.latency.p95{service="api"}'
{"status":"success","data":{"result":[{"metric":{},"value":[1995012345,"0.130"]}]}}
```
raj-sre: p95/p99 look present in backend, so likely a frontend/transform or dashboard mapping issue.
maria-platform: I see an error in console logs around panel rendering:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'quantiles' of undefined at renderPanel (dash-viz.bundle.js:45:12)
```
maria-platform: repro steps: open dashboard -> time range Last 1h -> project scope -> toggle "percentiles" on panel -> nothing shows
oliver-support: created ticket SUP-2143 and escalated to SRE; customer looped in.
maria-platform: hypothesis: recent aggregator change renamed series label from `quantile` -> `percentiles` during the canary, so the dashboard's transform can't find expected field.
raj-sre: patch: update transform to accept both labels, rolling out to console staging now.
maria-platform: temporary workaround for customer: switch panel "metric key" to use raw `redwood.latency.p95` series instead of composite transform.
claire-cs: customer verified workaround works and can see p95/p99 values again :thumbsup: \n
maria-platform: follow-up: will push a fix to the dashboard transform and roll out to prod canary in ~30m.
oliver-support: thanks, please add postmortem notes to #postmortems when fixed.
claire-cs: adding a note to the CS ticket, marking customer notified.
maria-platform: marking thread resolved for now :white_check_mark:
